rows.name:
Zazadan is injured and unable to move after a monster[XENO:n ]
attack. He hasn't eaten in ages and is about to collapse.[XENO:n ]
Bring him some food.

Obtain 2 [System:Color name=item ]Twin Flamii Eggs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Flamii in Satorl Marsh.

Collect 5 [System:Color name=item ]Lemon Stones[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

You fed the starving Zazadan. But[XENO:n ]
his injuries don't seem to have healed yet.

Zazadan is too afraid of monsters to go outside.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters responsible[XENO:n ]
and put his mind at ease.

Defeat 8 [System:Color name=item ]Ogre Bunnias[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

You defeated the monsters that attacked Zazadan.[XENO:n ]
But something still seems to be worrying him.

Zazadan remembered that the monsters that attacked him[XENO:n ]
had a leader.[XENO:n ]
Defeat it to put his mind at ease.

Near Void Marsh in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Sunlight Schvaik[/System:Color] (daytime only).
Return to Zazadan.

This time, you've dealt with the monsters that attacked[XENO:n ]
Zazadan, but his recovery doesn't seem to be going well.

Zazadan still hasn't recovered.[XENO:n ]
Obtain a medicine called Nopon Potion,[XENO:n ]
which heals injuries and illnesses in no time.

Near Lacus Swamp in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Nopon Potion[/System:Color].
Return to Zazadan.

Thanks to the Nopon Potion,[XENO:n ]
Zazadan recovered in no time.

Dipping a Red Pollen Orb into the Shining Pond[XENO:n ]
apparently makes something amazing.[XENO:n ]
Follow Zazadan's instructions.

Examine the Shining Pond near[XENO:n ]
Dark Swamp in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Zazadan.

The Red Pollen Orb turned into Highmore Caviar.[XENO:n ]
Zazadan was delighted.

Zazadan asked you to deliver Highmore Caviar.[XENO:n ]
Take it to a male Nopon named Daboll.

Find the Nopon named Daboll[XENO:n ]
and speak to him.

You delivered the Highmore Caviar to Daboll.[XENO:n ]
What could it possibly be used for?

Zazadan seems to know something.[XENO:n ]
Interrogate him about the secret organisation.

Interrogate Zazadan who is in the Nopon Refuge[XENO:n ]
of Satorl Marsh.

Continue your interrogation of Zazadan who is[XENO:n ]
in the Nopon Refuge of Satorl Marsh.

Force a confession out of Zazadan who is in the[XENO:n ]
Nopon Refuge of Satorl Marsh.

You might find Daboll with the note Zazadan[XENO:n ]
left behind. Ask Garuda to read it for you.

Kacha the scholar was abducted by the Ignas.[XENO:n ]
They seem to want to know something.[XENO:n ]
Head to Exile Fortress and rescue Kacha.

Save Kacha who is in Exile Fortress in[XENO:n ]
Satorl Marsh.
Return to Godo.

You rescued Kacha unharmed.[XENO:n ]
However, Kacha revealed the secret to the Ignas.

The Ignas seek the Hidden Door Key[XENO:n ]
to obtain the Giants' treasure.[XENO:n ]
Prevent the Ignas from taking the treasure.

On the plateau above Dark Swamp in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat 5 [System:Color name=item ]Deluded Ignas[/System:Color].

Near the plateau above Dark Swamp in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
dig up the [System:Color name=item ]Hidden Door Key[/System:Color].

Investigate the altar on the roof of Exile Fortress[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Kacha.

You thwarted the Ignas and protected the Giants' treasure.[XENO:n ]
Kacha can apparently tell you about the altar.

Obtaining the Giants' treasure apparently requires[XENO:n ]
some sort of ritual.[XENO:n ]
Obtain the Giants' Mirror and offer it at the altar.

Near Daksha Shrine on the Giant God's Leg,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Giants' Mirror[/System:Color].

Offer the Giants' Mirror at the altar[XENO:n ]
on Exile Fortress's roof in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Kacha.

You obtained Giants' Courage from the rooftop altar.[XENO:n ]
According to Kacha, one alone seems to be of no use.

Godo's back hurts, so he needs help setting up camp.[XENO:n ]
Gather materials for bedding.

Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Glowing Upa Seeds[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Upas in Satorl Marsh.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Fancy Volff Hides[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
from Volff in Satorl Marsh.

Collect 4 [System:Color name=item ]Feather Leaves[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Collect 3 [System:Color name=item ]Wool Rocks[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.
Return to Godo.

The materials have made some soft, fluffy bedding.[XENO:n ]
Godo should be able to rest properly now.

A Nopon was apparently nearly eaten by a Grog.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters so it never happens again.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Detox Grogs[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

You fulfilled the Nopon Merchant Company's request.[XENO:n ]
That should spare them any more frights.

Monsters are apparently disrupting campsite preparations.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.

Defeat 3 [System:Color name=item ]Coppice Claudes[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

You fulfilled the Nopon Merchant Company's request.[XENO:n ]
They can set up camp safely now.

Nopon tend to travel during the day and often encounter[XENO:n ]
frightening monsters in Void Marsh.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monsters.

Defeat 2 [System:Color name=item ]Mist Roguls[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

You fulfilled the Nopon Merchant Company's request.[XENO:n ]
They should be able to travel safely by day now.

Ferocious monsters have been attacking the campsite.[XENO:n ]
To ease the burden on Godo, the oldest of the group,[XENO:n ]
defeat the monsters.

Defeat 1 [System:Color name=item ]Officer Volff[/System:Color][XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

You fulfilled the Nopon Merchant Company's request.[XENO:n ]
The camp should be safe from attack now.

A fierce wolf appeared during a search for food[XENO:n ]
on a foggy night. Food shortages will only worsen.[XENO:n ]
Defeat the monster.

At Silent Obelisk in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Veteran Yozel[/System:Color].

Report to the male High Entia near the Sororal[XENO:n ]
Statues.

You fulfilled the High Entia refugees' request.[XENO:n ]
They should be able to search for food now.

Rosa's dear friend Gangu became a Telethia before her[XENO:n ]
eyes, but left without attacking her.[XENO:n ]
Ask around to learn where he went.

Talk to Seagal[XENO:n ]
in Satorl Marsh.

Talk to Galba[XENO:n ]
in Frontier Village.

Talk to Atael[XENO:n ]
in Frontier Village.
Return to Rosa.

You spoke to residents of the capital across the land.[XENO:n ]
Gangu seems to be in Revelation Hall.

As a Telethia, Gangu still guards the Imperial Palace.[XENO:n ]
But he's probably lost all sense of self by now.[XENO:n ]
Put him out of his misery.

At Revelation Hall in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Gangu[/System:Color].
Return to Rosa.

As feared, Gangu had lost his sense of self.[XENO:line ][XENO:n ]
But he should finally be able to rest now.

You learned that the other guards, just like Gangu,[XENO:n ]
are still guarding the Imperial Palace.[XENO:n ]
Put them out of their misery, too.

Near the Great Hall in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Rokuro[/System:Color].

Near the Imperial Villa in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Guarda[/System:Color].

Near the Sky Terrace in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Kaito[/System:Color].

Near the Audience Chamber in Imperial Capital Achamoth,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Telethia Donna[/System:Color].
Return to Rosa.

The Imperial Palace guards have fallen and are[XENO:n ]
at rest. They fulfilled their duty to the very end.

Imperial ceremonies were once held in Satorl Marsh.[XENO:n ]
You might find something useful in the battles ahead.

Gather the phosphorescence needed for the ceremony[XENO:n ]
from all over the world.

Offer the phosphorescence to the emblem[XENO:n ]
at the Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh.

At the Sororal Statues in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
defeat [System:Color name=item ]Halo Pterix[/System:Color].

You gathered the phosphorescence and held the ceremony.[XENO:n ]
Defeating the guardian that appeared yielded a royal key.

Phosphorescence can apparently be found at places[XENO:n ]
associated with the High Entia across the world.[XENO:n ]
Travel the world and obtain it.

Near Basin Cave in Satorl Marsh,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Mist Phosphorescence[/System:Color].

Near the Central Seal Island in Eryth Sea,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Ocean Phosphorescence[/System:Color].

Near Ceremony Hall in the High Entia Tomb,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Imperial Phosphorescence[/System:Color].

Near Sealed Tower on Valak Mountain,[XENO:n ]
obtain the [System:Color name=item ]Snow-Ice Phosphorescence[/System:Color].

Now that you've gathered the scattered phosphorescence,[XENO:n ]
return to Satorl Marsh to perform the ceremony.

Nopon Merchant Company: Only the ancient High Entia[XENO:n ]
Coming-of-Age Ceremony opens the way up the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
Perform it at the Sororal Statues' Adulthood Emblem.
Complete preparations for the ceremony.
Present proof at the Adulthood Emblem and perform the rite.
Defeat the Satorl Guardian.

The ancient High Entia Coming-of-Age Ceremony is complete.[XENO:n ]
The way to the Giant God's upper levels should now open.

The ancient High Entia Coming-of-Age Ceremony needs proof.[XENO:n ]
Gather the four tokens scattered in Satorl Marsh[XENO:n ]
to prepare for the ceremony.
Igna Territory proof:[XENO:n ]Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Blue Phosphorescence[/System:Color].
Altar of Fate proof:[XENO:n ]Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Rainbow Phosphorescence[/System:Color].
Dark Swamp proof:[XENO:n ]Obtain [System:Color name=item ]Dull Phosphorescence[/System:Color].
Basin Cave proof:[XENO:n ]Obtain [System:Color name=item ]White Phosphorescence[/System:Color].

All four tokens are gathered. Preparations are complete.[XENO:n ]
Perform the ceremony before the Sororal Statues.
